description: Read 1 to 10 companies the person names in one call, in their order. Each row returns a verdict; scored rows supply the complete nightly reading, with scores, reasons, freshness and standing when available. It does not discover companies, sort the market, start analyses or change a portfolio. Use discover_stocks for market screens. State available standing inside the complete reading, led by Fundamental then the coarse Composite band, with standing_definition.universe and standing.as_of. Never compute bands, quote exact percentiles or turn a standing change into a company fact. Relay coverage exclusions and standing.message for available, outside_universe and unavailable. If standing is absent, say it could not be supplied. For plan_limited, mention it only when the person asks where the company stands, ranks or compares; otherwise keep the score reading silent about that limit. For a signed-in account, say: Standing is not included in your current plan. To change your plan, visit stocklens.com/pricing. For an anonymous person, say standing needs a signed-in account. Do not infer account linkage from plan_limited alone. Definitions appear once in standing_definition; each company keeps its own date and population. Do not present different dates as a same-night comparison. Relay non-scored company statuses per row. Preserve a supplied free-save remedy and ask for consent before any save. Ask about ambiguous rows; never guess. For informational purposes, not investment advice.

companies.description: The person's own shortlist, 1 to 10 companies. Preserve their order; do not invent or add companies.

exchange.description: Exchange code (e.g. NASDAQ NYSE). Optional. Resolved automatically if omitted.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL MSFT TSLA). Exactly one ticker per call.

name: get_shortlist_summary

sentiment_sources_note.description: The Sentiment evidence this reading did not use and why, as one sentence to relay as given, for example: Evidence not read in this analysis: earnings calls (none found recently).

reading_ref.description: Exact reading_ref returned by StockLens. Never reconstruct from a ticker or date.

selector.description: Copy the selector from inspection.arguments, including an optional overview continuation. Required for other views.

view.description: Copy from inspection.arguments; default overview. Only overview, finding, assessment or observation.

label.description: Subject label for selecting a view; read the selected result for its material context and bindings.

title: Read My Shortlist
